title: Date and Tahini Energy Bites
summary: Soft, chewy little bites with caramel-like dates and nutty tahini, finished with sesame and a hint of vanilla. They make a simple Middle Eastern-style vegan dessert or snack for when you want something sweet without turning on the oven.
steps: If the dates are dry, soak them in hot water for 5 minutes, then drain well.
Add the dates, tahini, rolled oats, desiccated coconut, maple syrup, vanilla extract and a pinch of salt to a food processor.
Blend until the mixture comes together into a sticky paste. Scrape down the sides as needed; the mixture should hold together when pressed.
Roll the mixture into 12 small balls using damp hands.
Roll each ball in sesame seeds to coat lightly.
Chill for 10 minutes to firm up before serving, or keep in the fridge until needed.
